title: Selling Plans Seller Terms — Disputing a Billed Fee
content:
**Terms.** A seller on **Selling Plans** may dispute a fee record no later than the fee dispute window counted in calendar days from that fee's billing date, and at most the disputes-per-fee limit may be filed on one fee record. A dispute is upheld only when the plan, order and listing records show the fee was billed wrongly: a fee on an order that was cancelled before capture, a fee group that does not match the item category map, a second record for the same order and fee type, a standing discount not applied although the standing level and handling time qualified, or an insertion fee on a listing that was within the allowance. A rejected dispute books nothing.

> **Retired clause — no longer in force.** "An upheld dispute credits the overcharged difference with no administration fee." This clause is no longer in force and is superseded by the current basis.

## The dispute window

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Clock starts | The disputed fee's billing date, as shown on the fee record |
| Length | The plan's fee dispute window, in calendar days |
| Direction | The dispute is filed no later than the last day of the window |
| Last day | Included: a dispute filed on the last day is in time |
| Authority | The billing date on the fee record in the system, checked before any credit is booked on the dispute |

**Both sides of the boundary (hypothetical fee billed on 1 March, 90-day window).** The ninetieth calendar day after 1 March is 30 May. A dispute filed on 30 May is in time; a dispute filed on 31 May is outside the window.

## Grounds on which a dispute is upheld

A dispute is upheld only when the plan, order and listing records show one of these:

| Ground | What the records show |
|---|---|
| Fee on an order cancelled before capture | The order was cancelled before its payment was captured |
| Wrong fee group | The fee group on the record does not match the item category map |
| Duplicate fee | A second record exists for the same order and fee type |
| Standing discount missing | The standing discount was not applied although the standing level and handling time qualified |
| Insertion fee within the allowance | An insertion fee was booked on a listing that was within the allowance |

When none of these is shown by the records, the dispute is not upheld; a rejected dispute books nothing.

## Points of judgement

- **One dispute per fee record.** At most the disputes-per-fee limit may be filed on one fee record; the limit is counted per fee record.
- **Records, not recollection.** The ground must be shown by the plan, order and listing records.
